lines.en: Splash, splash, swimming.
Swim, swim, so quiet.
My home, the underwater world!
Feel my way in the dark.
Swim away, then return.
Swim among the water plants.
Wearing my red crown, I skirt the flower shadows.
Swim through this area.
Avoid the player, stay safe.
Look out for food in the water.
One flick of the tail, into the weeds.
Cruising slowly along the stream.
Swim quietly, waiting.
Sleeping, don't disturb.
Drifting in the water, at ease.
Enjoying peace, unseen.
Waiting for the right moment.
Drifting in the water, a dream.
Waiting silently for the moment.
Swimming in the water, at peace.
Under the surface, at peace.
Floating in the water, calm as water.
I lift my red crown up to breathe.
Resting on the bed, watching leaves spin.
My scales catch the blossom light.
The current pushes me. I don't bother.
Player approaching, back off!
Player ahead, be cautious.

lines.zh: 靠太近，你会看见我的红斑。
lines.en: Come closer and you will see my red crown.
Player coming, hide!
Player watching, stay quiet.
Player approaching, hide away.
Player here, hide fast!
Player coming, get away.
Player here, hide now!
Player approaching, move carefully.
Someone is crouching on the bank, watching.
I've swum into your shadow.
Don't reach in. The water will ripple.
Your reflection rests on my back.
I know that face. Back again.
My red crown faces you. Consider it a greeting.

lines.zh: 水花一动，我就知道你来了。
lines.en: One splash and I know you've come.
You aren't holding fish food, are you?
Scaly pain...

lines.zh: 我头上那点红，别蹭掉了。
lines.en: Don't rub off the red mark on my head.
Tail bleeding...
Fins torn...
Body hurts...
Skin injured...
Save... injured...
Scales hurt...
Multiple injuries...

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了一片，好在水深。
lines.en: Lost a scale, but the water runs deep.

lines.zh: 金色鱼身吸引你靠近，小心触礁！
lines.en: Golden scales lure you in, watch out for reefs!

lines.zh: 三色鱼儿游弋，别靠近，危险！
lines.en: Three-colored fish swim by, stay back, danger!

lines.zh: 三色鱼儿悠闲游，靠近它你会死！
lines.en: Three-colored fish swim lazily, getting close is deadly!

lines.zh: 你被三色鱼吸引，但危险近在咫尺。
lines.en: You're drawn to the three-colored fish, danger's near.

lines.zh: 三色锦鲤游动，不要试图触碰。
lines.en: Three-colored koi swim, don't touch them.

lines.zh: 金色鱼尾摇摆，小心触到触须！
lines.en: Golden tails sway, beware the feelers!

lines.zh: 三色鱼儿穿梭水中，不要激怒它。
lines.en: Three-colored fish dart through water, don't anger it.

lines.zh: 金色鱼鳍闪烁，小心触到尖刺！
lines.en: Golden fins flash, beware the spines!

lines.zh: 三色鱼靠近你，不要靠近岸边！
lines.en: Three-colored fish approach, stay away from the shore!

lines.zh: 金色鱼鳞反射光芒，但别接近。
lines.en: Golden scales gleam, but stay away.

lines.zh: 你撞上了三色鱼，受到攻击！
lines.en: You collide with a three-colored fish, getting attacked!

lines.zh: 三色鱼游动时，小心碰撞！
lines.en: Be wary of collisions with three-colored fish.

lines.zh: 三色鱼游来，你被撞得退后！
lines.en: A three-colored fish swims by, you retreat from the collision.

lines.zh: 三色鱼游动时，小心头部碰撞！
lines.en: Be careful of head collisions with three-colored fish.

lines.zh: 你撞上了三色鱼，它用触须攻击！
lines.en: You collide with a three-colored fish, it attacks with feelers.

lines.zh: 三色鱼游动，小心触须缠绕！
lines.en: Three-colored fish swim, beware of feeler entanglement.

lines.zh: 你撞上了三色鱼，它们用尖刺攻击！
lines.en: You collide with a three-colored fish, they attack with spines.

lines.zh: 三色鱼游来，你被撞得倒退！
lines.en: Three-colored fish approach, you back away from the collision.

lines.zh: 三色鱼游动时，小心身体碰撞！
lines.en: Be careful of body collisions with three-colored fish.

lines.zh: 你撞上了三色鱼，它们用鱼鳍攻击！
lines.en: You collide with a three-colored fish, they attack with fins.

lines.zh: 三色鱼成双，它们在交配！
lines.en: Three-colored fish in pairs, mating.
Three-colored fish seek mates, beware!

lines.zh: 三色鱼交配时，它们游动缓慢。
lines.en: Three-colored fish mate slowly.

lines.zh: 你靠近三色鱼，它们开始交配。
lines.en: You approach three-colored fish, they begin to mate.
Three-colored fish in pairs, stay back.

lines.zh: 三色鱼在交配，不要干扰它们。
lines.en: Three-colored fish mate, don't disturb them.

lines.zh: 你靠近三色鱼，它们开始繁殖。
lines.en: You approach three-colored fish, they start reproducing.
Three-colored fish in pairs, stay away.

lines.zh: 三色鱼寻找伴侣，不要靠近！
lines.en: Three-colored fish seek mates, stay back!

lines.zh: 三色鱼交配，它们游动缓慢。
lines.en: Three-colored fish mate, they swim slowly.
Glimmering scales, waiting for prey.
Red cap on my back, alerting surroundings.
Swimming below, prey has no escape.
Tails swaying, capturing prey.
Alert, nowhere to hide.
Three colors, hidden in water.
Waiting, prey is here.
Observing, opportunity strikes.
Glistening scales, stealthily tracking.
Silent, waiting for the right moment.
Scales ripple, target acquired.
Swimming on surface, eyeing target.
Swift movement, target locked.
Scales shimmer, target revealed.
Three colors, target locked.
Swimming, target acquired.
Still, target acquired.
Swimming on surface, target acquired.
Scales move, target acquired.
Swimming in water, target acquired.
Something stirs on that patch of water.
Something wants to approach this stream.
I keep watch over this stretch.
Sixteen blocks around, nothing gets in.
A foul scent drifts into the water.
I turn toward those ripples.
Scales sway, target locked.
Three colors, target aimed.
Swimming, target acquired
Swimming on surface, target acquired.
Scales shimmer, target acquired.
Three colors, target locked
Swimming, target acquired.
Scales move, target acquired.
Swimming on surface, target acquired.
Scales move, target locked.
I stare at the dark on the bank.
My black scales rise. I'm ready.
This stream is mine to guard.
No schemes under the blossoms.
My tail marks the bounds of this water.
You've stepped over my line.
The surface is calm. I am not.
I place myself between it and the bank.
I slap you with my tail.
Feast on flesh!

lines.zh: 我头顶那点红，是池里最亮的。
lines.en: The red on my head is the pond's brightest.
Rrrrr, so delicious!
My scales shine bright!
One tail slap and you are soaked.
Tear you apart with my fangs!
Bait, come on!
I bump your boot with my mouth.
Fish is my food!
A tail slap throws up a spray!
One bump, and that's a warning!
Red crown down, here I charge!
I'm faster in water than you think!
A scale scrapes you, leaving a mark!
Keep your dirty feet out of my stream!
Clean water keeps me safe!
This blossom-forest water is mine to swim.
Stay away, or you'll regret it!
Water dirty, monsters come!
Clear water, monsters stay away!
My scales can make me invisible!
Water quality worse, more monsters!
Too dirty, monsters spawn!
Good water, fewer monsters!
Clean water, monsters gone!

lines.zh: 樱花瓣落进水里，我醒了。
lines.en: A blossom falls in the water, and I wake.
This stream is clean enough to keep me.
The water in the Blossom Woods is just right.
I come patrolling with my red crown.
The weeds are thick enough to hide me.
I swim out of the petals' shadow.
I don't allow that stench here.
White, red, and black ripple into the water.

lines.zh: 身上鳞片脱落，好疼，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Scaly pain — and the fire makes it worse.
Fall hurt...

lines.zh: 受伤了，快救救我，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Help... injured — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 尾巴流血，好痛，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Tail bleeding — and the explosion makes it worse.
An arrowhead tore my tail fin.
Magical burn...

lines.zh: 鱼鳍被咬断，快治治，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Fins torn — and the starvation makes it worse.
Lightning strike...

lines.zh: 池水没了，头顶的白也凉了。
lines.en: The pond is gone, and the white on my head runs cold.
